dict.string: Umoja listens on this Mac so you can talk to it. Your voice is recognised on the device and never leaves it.
Umoja turns your speech into text on this Mac, without sending it anywhere.
Keeper reads your calendar on this Mac to tell you what is coming up and to add events you ask for. Your calendar is never sent anywhere.

Keeper looks up people in your contacts on this Mac when you ask about them. Your contacts are never sent anywhere.
